remarks:
This is a unique opportunity to own an established Airbnb campground consisting of a cabin and 3 yurts on 13.2 acres located in Ellicottville NY, Cattaraugus County.

This property is located just minutes from downtown Ellicottville and Holiday Valley. It features three exceptionally clean and well-maintained full-size yurts, along with an insulated cabin, offering an excellent opportunity to take over an existing hospitality business and expand its potential.

Two of the yurts are comfortably designed to accommodate up to four guests each, while the third serves as a community gathering space, perfect for shared meals, group activities, and relaxation. The property also includes an insulated cabin with a sleeping loft, existing solar power, and generator-ready wiring. The cabin offers plenty of potential for additional improvements or expansion.

More than 70 percent of the acreage remains undeveloped providing ample space for additional cabins, yurts, or other accommodations. An established apple orchard near the yurts produces several varieties of apples each year and attracts local wildlife adding to the property's natural charm. New walkways connect the yurts, while multiple walking trails wind throughout the property.

All accommodations are tucked away from the road creating a peaceful and secluded setting. A well-maintained gravel driveway leads from the main road to the property ending in a convenient circular parking area. Mansfield Creek flows through the acreage offering beautiful scenery and a tranquil atmosphere throughout the seasons.

The property has a capped well that is not currently in use. The new owner would need to install a septic system if desired, and electric service is available at the road.

With its established Airbnb setup, beautiful natural surroundings, and significant room for expansion, this property presents an exciting opportunity for investors, entrepreneurs, or anyone looking to create a one-of-a-kind getaway destination. Owner financing is available. All rights convey.
